name: Dataset of PCB Surface Defects (DsPCBSD+)
description: An image dataset for printed circuit board surface-defect detection, containing 10,259 images with 20,276 manually annotated defects across nine categories. Images are not vendored.
citation: Lv, S. et al. A dataset for deep learning based detection of printed circuit board surface defect. Scientific Data 11, 811 (2024). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-024-03656-8

license.notes: Dataset-specific license terms were not confirmed; review the upstream terms before use.
